sources.title: Iterative traversal writer fixture plus actual-candidate independent shape oracle
Iterative binary-tree traversal independent source-first review

claims.text: The preserved source only asks for a non-recursive binary-tree traversal implementation; traversal order and API details are answer-side choices.
The actual candidate implements iterative preorder, inorder and postorder using explicit stack state, with postorder tracking the last visited node by identity.
Writer randomized validation and independent all-shape validation match separately implemented recursive traversal oracles, including duplicate node values.
The actual candidate completes on a 30,000-node right-skewed tree without recursive traversal; each traversal is O(n) time with O(h) auxiliary stack space excluding output.

validation.command: writer randomized recursive-oracle fixture plus independently compiled actual-candidate all-shape oracle

boundary_tests.expected: postorder state based on node identity
no recursive traversal-depth dependency and correct three-order sequences

findings: Exact source boundary is preserved and broader traversal/API coverage is explicitly answer-side.
Actual candidate passes independent all-shape, duplicate-value and deep-chain validation.
Complexity, recursion-depth and Morris-traversal tradeoffs are accurately bounded.
